target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md slot 1 (part of the bearer: base, e.g. leaf base PO_0020040) + increased width (PATO_0000600)
reason: The quality is the width of the base, not of the whole organ; 'base' is the region slot (as in flora_context_words 'at the base'). PATO broad (PATO_0002359) means wider than long and does not fit; the examples are mixed, so not a term.

target: docs/odp/17-value-defined-by-a-measure.md: relative position of the widest point (FLOPO:0995011) at the base
reason: It states the position of greatest width (Manual of Leaf Architecture character 10), which pattern 17 models as a measure; widest in the proximal part makes the blade ovate (FLOPO:0991024) or triangular, and a term would duplicate the measure.
A colour between pink and buff, i.e. beige; PATO has no buff, and an intermediate colour is the continuum between two values (compare PATO pinkish white).
Same reading as rule C172 'narrowed' = tapered; 'towards the base' is the region word in flora_context_words.tsv and gives the direction.
An indefinite count of flowers like 'few-flowered' in pattern 13; flora_counted_parts.tsv already maps 'flowered' to flower.
As rule C175 'indistinct' = inconspicuous; the quality belongs to the veins (vascular bundle PO_0005020, synonym vein), which is the part of the bearer.

target: new: conjunction of two values (triangular PATO_0001875 + acuminate PATO_0002228)
reason: A triangular outline with an acuminate apex: two qualities of different attributes that both hold. This is not a continuum, so no single term is needed.

target: new: conjunction of two values (scaly PATO_0001804 + punctate PATO_0001512)
reason: Covered with scattered minute scales that look like dots: scaly and punctate both hold. Unlike stellate-lepidote (FLOPO:0991304), it says nothing new about the shape of the scales.
'scandent' is an exact synonym of FLOPO:0991108 climbing; 'not scandent' is its negation, like rule C239 unlobed.
A compound of two shape values, an elongated cone, handled like 'linear-lanceolate' as a continuum.

target: docs/odp/03-count-of-parts.md (2 leaves PO_0025034 per pseudobulb FLOPO_0986027; add 'phyllous' -> leaf to config/flora_counted_parts.tsv)
reason: Bearing two leaves: a count inside a word like '3-foliolate'. The counted-parts table has no 'phyllous' yet.
Villous all round (inside the petal or claw); 'within/inside' is the surface slot. Reading it as a ring of hairs (bearded FLOPO:0991118) is less certain, so the plain villous value is preferred.
The name of a measurement attribute, not a flora word; the examples are numbers, which belong to pattern 02 with the trichome (PO_0000282) as bearer.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md slot 1 (part of the bearer: apex) + resinous (FLOPO:0991075)
reason: Teeth ending in a resinous gland: the resinous quality of the tip. This is a rule over an existing value, not a new '-tipped' term like spine-tipped.
Hardly visible = not clearly visible, the reading of rules C174 and C175.
Bark cracked by intersecting fissures into blocks or strips; FLOPO:0991022 fissured (related synonym cracked) covers bark marked by deep cracks.
Hairs between villous and woolly (lanate, exact synonym woolly): a continuum of two pilosity values.
A plant growing in loose mats; 'loosely' is a degree kept in the record. PATO matted (PATO_0001607) means tangled and does not fit.
A compound of two plane-shape values, like 'linear-lanceolate'.

label: depressed ovate
definition: An ovate quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's outline being broader than long, entirely convex and broadest below the middle.
reason: A standard plane shape of the Systematics Association chart (width greater than length, widest towards the base). It is not a continuum: 'depressed' here is a width:length ratio below 1, not the 3-D FLOPO:0991103.

target: docs/odp/15-absence-of-a-part.md (needs a bearer for the petal callus; floret callus FLOPO_0986120 is the grass callus and does not fit)
reason: States that the calluses at the base of the standard petal are absent, which is pattern 15. There is no PO or FLOPO class for these legume calluses, so it cannot be annotated until a bearer exists.
Like structures (styles, filaments) united for half their length; FLOPO:0991067 connate (related synonym fused) gives the quality, and the extent 'to halfway' stays in the record.
A spelling variant of palmatipartite (synonyms palmatiparti, palmatipartit); '1/3-1/2 to base' is a depth that stays in the record.
Hairs lying almost flat; 'semi-' qualifies appressed as 'sub-' does in pattern 01. PATO semi erect (PATO_0002260) is the posture of a whole body.

target: docs/odp/01-approximate-value.md + docs/annotation-context-patterns.md continuum: oblong (PATO_0000946) to ovate (FLOPO:0991024)
reason: The approximate marker 'sub-' on the continuum oblong-ovate; both patterns already exist.
Sulphur is a pale, slightly greenish yellow; light yellow is the nearest PATO colour (lemon yellow PATO_0104321 is more saturated).
A nearly round outline slightly longer than wide (towards broadly elliptic); 'narrowly' qualifies orbicular approximately and does not name a new shape.
Castaneous = chestnut-brown; PATO_0104329 has chestnut-red and chestnut-brown as synonyms, which covers the reddish shade.
Stiff and ending in a sharp point; FLOPO:0991230 spine-like (related synonym spinescent) is the shape quality. The thorn/spine distinction lies in origin, not shape.
Same as rule C172 'narrowed'; 'basally' is the region word in flora_context_words.tsv.
